expr: (() => { const s=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const S=window.simState; return s[0].value==='0' && s[1].value==='1' && r[0].value==='1' && r[1].value==='1' && r[2].value==='0' && S.ilma===0 && S.mA===1 && S.mB===1 && S.t===0 && S.vA===0 && S.vB===0 && S.running===false ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const s=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'); const o=[...s[0].options].map(x=>x.value+':'+x.textContent).join('|'); return s.length===2 && o==='0:tyhjiö|1:ilma' ? 1 : 0 })()

speed select hidas 0.5, normaali 1, nopea 2

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Pudota' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Pudota first, then Alusta; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root label')]; const t=L.map((e)=>simText(e)); return L.length===5 && t[0].startsWith('Ympäristö') && /^Massa \$m_\\text\{A\} = .*\\,\\text\{kg\}\$$/.test(t[1]) && /^Massa \$m_\\text\{B\} = .*\\,\\text\{kg\}\$$/.test(t[2]) && /^Hetki \$t = .*\\,\\text\{s\}\$$/.test(t[3]) && t[4].startsWith('Nopeus (toisto)') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: five labelled controls: Ympäristö, Massa mA and mB with unit kg, Hetki t with unit s, Nopeus (toisto)

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words (explanations live in the lesson's inquiry.json)

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='ilma,mA,mB,t' && P.t.unit==='s' && P.mA.unit==='kg' && P.mB.unit==='kg' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares t (s), ilma, mA (kg) and mB (kg)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); return c.width===600 && c.height===400 ? 1 : 0; })()
